B1: L2 normalize equal arithmetic mean of L2 segment vectors, cosine

M1.checkpoint: earliest best validation loss; never test
M1.initialization: torch default Linear Kaiming uniform under seed
M1.pair: mean over all segment pairs of concatenated abs difference and product

evaluation.bootstrap: 2000 paired anchor replicates, PCG64 seed 20260908, sorted anchors, linear 95% percentiles
outcome_precedence: SUPPORTED if M1 vs B1 credible gain
COVERAGE_ONLY if B1 vs B0 credible gain
REPRESENTATION_LIMITED otherwise, explicitly limited to this small model and experiment

playlist_labels: separate descriptive inventory only; never primary training targets

segmentation.failure: explicit track failure; all chunks required, no replacement
segmentation.mel: Arm D get_mel; repeat same 1001x64 view four times; longer=False
segmentation.normalization: float64 L2 with norm > 1e-12 then float32
segmentation.ordering: track ID ascending then start sample ascending
segmentation.tail: cyclic repeat only final chunk samples to 480000
segmentation.timestamps: start and original end sample / 48000; padding excluded

split.artist_sensitivity: add connected components of every credited normalized artist; metadata for splitting only
split.group: connected components of shared source SHA or video ID
split.ordering: sha256(stage5g1:20260908:group-min-id), ascending; cumulative group track count
